name: tenders-hermes
description: Agent harness over the tenders-search-automation production pipeline
comment: tsx exists so the container can execute the production repo's TypeScript
adapters directly. It lives here rather than being used from /repo because
the repo's node_modules is installed on whatever host developed it (win32
esbuild on this machine) and the container is Linux.
playwright and cheerio are pinned to the SAME versions the production repo
declares, and are only a fallback: probe-core.mjs prefers /repo's copies
whenever the mount is present, so a diagnosis always runs the exact code
production runs. These local copies exist for deploy/verify-ip.sh, which
must work on a rented box with no access to the private repo — that check
decides whether a host is worth paying for, and it cannot be gated on
Keep the playwright version in step with docker/Dockerfile's base image:
the browsers ship in the image, and a mismatched client refuses to launch

scripts.check: node --check harness/db.mjs && node --check harness/digest.mjs && node --check harness/classify.mjs && node --check harness/notify.mjs && node --check harness/probe-all.mjs && node --check harness/compare-origins.mjs && node --check harness/lib/source.mjs && node --check harness/lib/supabase.mjs && node --check harness/lib/probe-core.mjs && node --check eval/score.mjs && node --check eval/build-set.mjs && node --check eval/make-holdout.mjs
